failure_modes.name: Evidence_Present_But_Missed
failure_modes.evidence: Summary 1 states: 'The passages confirm that "She's the Man" was inspired by William Shakespeare's play "Twelfth Night," but they do not contain information confirming that "Twelfth Night" is also known as "What You Will."' However, passage [5] from hop 1 states 'She's the Man is a 2006 American romantic sport-comedy film... Inspired by William Shakespeare's play "Twelfth Night"' which the solver acknowledged but claimed could not verify the alternative title.
